calendar.title: Booking calendar
calendar.description: Availability of the club's aircraft, day by day.
calendar.loadError: The bookings for this day could not be loaded. Check your connection and try again.

closed.title: Club closed
closed.description: Your flying club is closed on this day ({{day}})

noAircraft.title: No aircraft to book
noAircraft.description: The club's aircraft will appear here as soon as they are added to the fleet.

noHours.title: Booking hours not set
noHours.description: An administrator must enter the club's opening hours in the settings.

calendar.hint: Click a free slot, or drag across several, to book.

mobile.heading: Bookings for {{date}}
mobile.aircraftFree: This aircraft is free all day
mobile.emptyDescription: Use “New booking” to book a slot.
mobile.freeHint: Tap a slot to book it; you can adjust the times.

maintenance.title: Weekly maintenance
maintenance.description: From {{from}} to {{to}} the club's aircraft are in maintenance: this time cannot be booked.

form.createDescription: Check the chosen slot, then describe your flight.
form.editDescription: Change the aircraft or the times until the flight starts: the price is worked out again and the difference charged or refunded.
form.newDescription: Choose the aircraft, the day and the times of your flight.

errors.closedDay: The flying club is closed on that day.
errors.timeMissing: Enter the start time and the end time.
errors.timeOrder: The end time must be after the start time.
errors.past: A booking cannot start in the past.
errors.weeklyMaintenance: This slot runs into the weekly maintenance ({{from}} – {{to}}): choose another time.

instructor.label: With an instructor
instructor.requiredHint: Without a valid licence you fly with an instructor: choose the one for this flight. You pay for the aircraft; the instructor is notified and may decline.
instructor.optionalHint: Optional. With an instructor the flight becomes an instruction flight; the instructor is notified and may decline.

course.note: Booking the aircraft for {{student}}'s course with {{instructor}}. The student is the pilot of the flight: they pay for the aircraft and receive the confirmation.

detail.title: Booking details
detail.startedHint: This booking has started: it can no longer be changed, and only an administrator can cancel it.
detail.instructorHint: You are the instructor of this flight. You can decline it before it starts: the booking is cancelled and the student is refunded.

declineConfirm.title: Decline this instruction flight?
declineConfirm.description: The booking of {{aircraft}} on {{date}}, from {{start}} to {{end}}, will be cancelled. The student will be notified and refunded, and the slot will be free again.

slotUnavailable.title: Slot unavailable
slotUnavailable.description: The selection overlaps an existing booking. Choose free slots only.

accountNotLoaded.title: Booking not possible
accountNotLoaded.description: Your account is not loaded yet. Try again in a moment.

refused.title: Booking refused
refused.description: The booking could not be created. Check your connection and try again.

updated.title: Booking updated
updated.description: The booking of {{aircraft}} has been changed.

updateFailed.title: Could not save changes
updateFailed.description: The booking could not be changed. Try again in a moment.

cancelled.title: Booking cancelled
cancelled.description: The booking of {{aircraft}} has been cancelled.

cancelFailed.title: Could not cancel
cancelFailed.description: The booking could not be cancelled. Try again in a moment.

templateSaveFailed.title: Could not save
templateSaveFailed.description: The template could not be saved. Try again in a moment.

templateDeleteFailed.title: Could not delete
templateDeleteFailed.description: The template could not be deleted. Try again in a moment.

slotPast.title: Slot in the past
slotPast.description: This slot has already started. Choose an upcoming slot.

my.title: My bookings
my.description: Your aircraft bookings and the templates that save you time.

empty.title: No bookings yet
empty.description: Book an aircraft from the calendar: your bookings will appear here.
empty.filteredDescription: Change the search or the filters to find your bookings.

instruction.intro: The instruction flights booked with you. You can decline a flight before it starts: the student is then refunded.

empty.title: No instruction flight
empty.description: Bookings where a member chooses you as their instructor will appear here.

template.intro: A template pre-fills the booking form for your usual flights.

empty.title: No booking template
empty.description: Save your usual flights (aircraft, times, category) to book in two clicks.

deleteConfirm.title: Delete this template?
deleteConfirm.description: The template “{{name}}” will be permanently deleted. Your existing bookings are not changed.

form.stepSlotDescription: Optional: the day and times suggested when you use the template.
form.name: Template name

price.unchanged: The price only changes if you change the aircraft or the times.
price.differenceCharged: {{paid}} already paid: {{amount}} more will be taken from {{account}}
price.differenceRefunded: {{paid}} already paid: {{amount}} will be refunded to {{account}}

cancel.title: Cancel this booking?
cancel.description: The booking of {{aircraft}} on {{date}}, from {{start}} to {{end}}, will be cancelled and the slot will be free again.

refund.self: {{amount}} will be refunded to your balance.
refund.pilot: {{amount}} will be refunded to the pilot's balance.
refund.none: Nothing will be refunded: no amount was charged for this booking.
